requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of product reference names for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series on 123.hp.com to a single, consistent reference name to minimize user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be able to reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types, meeting intervention specifications for different media and climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate as intended without mechanical failure (e.g., input tray sensor flag) when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, tablecloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess if the printer experiences any functional failure when tilted left or right at 20 degrees during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Verify that the printer does not experience print quality issues when printing while placed on a trolley.
